overview: NEDFi (North Eastern Development Finance Corporation Limited) is a public financial institution established to provide financial assistance and support to micro, small, medium, and large enterprises in the North Eastern Region of India. It offers a range of loan products including project finance, working capital loans, loans for women entrepreneurs, artisans, doctors, professionals, and specialized sectors like tea industry. NEDFi also acts as the nodal agency for disbursing Government of India subsidies and incentives in the region under schemes such as NEIIPP 2007 and NEIDS 2017, and provides consultancy, advisory, and capacity-building services.
geographic_scope: North Eastern Region of India (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura)
objectives: Provide financial assistance to micro, small, medium, and large enterprises for setting up industrial, infrastructure, and agri-allied projects in the North Eastern Region
Support microfinance through MFI/NGOs for on-lending to needy individuals in rural areas for income-generating activities
Offer consultancy and advisory services to state governments, private sectors, and other agencies
Conduct sector or state-specific studies under the Techno-Economic Development Fund (TEDF)
Act as the designated nodal agency for disbursal of Government of India incentives to industries in the North-East under NEIIPP 2007
Promote entrepreneurship and livelihood enhancement through CSR initiatives and skill development programs
Strengthen institutional capacity and provide monitoring and evaluation support for funded projects
Facilitate market linkage for artisans and handicrafts through initiatives like NE-SHILP and NEDFi Haat
eligibility: Eligibility varies by loan product but generally includes: entities such as sole proprietors, partnership firms, LLPs, private Ltd. companies; businesses must be based in the North Eastern Region; satisfactory credit history; for specific loans: women entrepreneurs (aged 18-50, skilled, in manufacturing/services), doctors (qualified MBBS/BAMS/BDS/BHMS/BUMS), professionals (CAs, CS, architects, etc. with 2+ years experience), artisans (registered/unregistered, no existing bank loans), MFIs (regulated, RBI-compliant, 3+ years existence, NE-based), and projects under subsidy-linked schemes must have subsidy receivables from competent authorities (e.g., NEIIPP 2007, NEIDS 2017).
benefits: Financial benefits include term loans up to 2 Cr for doctors, 50 Lakhs for professionals, 3 Cr for tea industry, 1 Lakh for artisans, up to 90% of liquid security value, up to 75% of project cost for MSME/business loans, up to 66.67% for tea units, up to 85% for artisans, up to 50% of subsidy receivable for short-term subsidy loans. Non-financial benefits: advisory & consultancy services (financial, capacity building, transaction & bid, infrastructure, strategy, operations, monitoring & evaluation, program management), skill development studies, market linkage via NEDFi Haat and NE-SHILP, business facilitation model, and support for MSME revitalization and cluster development.
financial_support: NEDFi provides term loans and short-term loans with interest rates starting from 6% p.a. (for artisans) to 12.25% p.a. (for MFIs), processing fees ranging from 0.5% to 1% + GST, repayment periods from 12 to 84 months, and moratorium periods up to 12 months. Loan amounts are typically a percentage of project cost or security value (e.g., 75% of project cost for MSME loans, 90% of liquid security, 50% of subsidy receivable). Funding is disbursed after due diligence, documentation verification, and sanction by appropriate credit committees. Security includes hypothecation of assets, personal/corporate guarantees, and lien on subsidy receivables or liquid securities.
application_process: 1. Identify the suitable loan product based on business type and needs. 2. Visit the NEDFi website or nearest branch to access the loan application form. 3. Fill out the application form with details of the entity, promoters, and project. 4. Gather required documents including KYC (identity, address), business proof (trade license, MOA, AOA, GST, ITR), and project-specific documents. 5. Submit the application along with documents to NEDFi (online or at branch). 6. NEDFi officials conduct due diligence and verification of submitted information. 7. Application is forwarded to the appropriate sanctioning authority (e.g., Branch Credit Committee, Corporate Credit Committee). 8. Upon approval, a sanction letter is issued with terms and conditions. 9. Complete security creation and documentation as per sanction terms. 10. Loan is disbursed to the borrower’s account post-fulfillment of all conditions.
required_documents: Photo identity and Address proof (as per RBI KYC guidelines)
Business Proof: Trade License/MOA & AOA/GST Registration/ITR, Partnership Deed
KYC details of organization and board/executive members
Recent passport size photographs of directors/partners
Subsidy receivable sanction letter (for short-term loan against central subsidy)
Liquid security documents (for loan against liquid security)
Project cost details and promoter contribution proof
NOC from existing lenders (if subsidy is lien-marked elsewhere)
Tea Board NOC/Registration (for specialty tea industry loan)
Artisan registration or practice proof (for artisan loan)
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: North Eastern Development Finance Corporation Limited (NEDFi)
contact_details: Helpline: 0361-222-2200 | Email: mail@nedfi.com | Head Office: NEDFi House, G. S. Road, Dispur, Guwahati, Assam - 781006
caveats: Loans are exclusively for units/businesses located in the North Eastern Region of India
Certain loans (e.g., working capital loan) are applicable only for existing businesses
Promoter’s contribution is mandatory (minimum 15%-35% of project cost depending on scheme)
Subsidy must not be lien-marked with any other bank/institution; otherwise, NOC from lender is required
Loan amount is capped (e.g., max ₹15 lakhs project cost for women entrepreneurs, max ₹1 lakh for artisans)
No Detailed Project Report required for loans up to ₹25 lakhs (varies by scheme)
Interest rates are subject to change and start from specified minimum rates
Processing fees and other charges are applicable as per NEDFi’s charge structure
Certain loans have restrictions on end-use (e.g., MFIs must use funds only for income generation of ultimate borrowers)
Beneficiaries must comply with RBI norms and NEDFi’s KYC/AML policies
